source: Pass a {0}Standard Schema{/0} (such as Zod, Valibot or ArkType) with {1}, or bind it to the form as {2}, to validate the input. A schema that implements Standard JSON Schema, such as a Zod schema, or a Valibot schema wrapped in {3} from {4}, also describes the input to the agent. Otherwise, types come from the current values and the native controls. Labels become descriptions.
